restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: This clinic is very good for me. Doctor is gentle, knowledgeable, and explains things in an easy way.  Nurses are friendly and helpful. I felt relaxed and safe during my visit. Thank you for the excellent service.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text:
Saw a wonderful doctor there who spoke very good English post- a Muay Thai injury. Ascertained that my toe wasn’t broken - just swollen and infected inside the skin. Prescribed a course of antibiotics and a tetanus jab - all done within an hour. Toe has healed well after a week or so. Local Thai prices (all in for 670 baht) as it serves the local Thai community - though still very willing to help me as a young British male. Helpful, capable and friendly nurses and staff.

Likely best to arrive at around 7.30am before the clinic opens to be within the first customers as many arrive around 8am. There are two entrances - maybe best to stand/sit at the entrance facing the coffee shop as that is where most people line up. I sat on the side entrance and had to be saved by a lovely Thai lady who knew I was second in line as I arrived a 7.15am or so.

I can recommend very highly - I will aim to go again should I ever be in Chiang Mai and need to visit a clinic.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: Very good! I went there today because I stubbed my toe and thought it might be broken. I went for the opening at 8am and it was already very full. Though it took me only around 1,5 hours (which includes 1h wait to see the doctor after arriving) to walk out after speaking to the doctor, X-rays, medicine, and a gaze. The doctor speaks English very well and I paid 840 baht for everything (doctor 200, X-rays 300, multiple medication 350).

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: I had a bad cough and wanted to get looked at by an english speaking doctor and was lucky enough to find this clinic. Everyone was calm and orderly, I was checked, got an xray and was given meds. Just amazing! Our doctors at home have alot to learn from them. Dr spoke english, clearly explained everything, no stress at all. They open at 8am. If you want to you can get there earlier as there will be a queue. Payment is in cash only after treatment. You wait till you are called and the whole process took 90 mins, but so calm and everyone waits their turn patiently. After the xray and seeing the dr again, he gave me a full explanation of which meds etc and the pharmacy there prepared and gave them to me. And all this for 720 bht! And without computers, just human beings treating human beings. I was so worried about being sick in Thailand and this place completely upturned my preconceptions! Big Thanks to this clinic

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text:
Came at a 10am on a weekday as it was near my hotel, there were like 60+ people waiting. Front desk said it would take 2 hours so I left to go elsewhere.

It is more like a local clinic. If you are a tourist who has travel insurance there are other clinics to go to that don’t have such a long wait.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text:
Excellent! I went here today due to severe pain in my elbow. The doctor as well as the whole staff speak English. The doctor examined me very thoroughly and made an x-ray of my elbow (at the clinic). He reviewed the results and prescribed me the adequate medicine, which I received at the clinic as well. For the examination including x-ray and medicine I only paid 1.020 Baht, which is very fair. I also received proper documentation (invoice and prescription) for my insurance. I can highly recommend this clinic!

They open at 8 am. I arrived at 7:45 am and was number 4 in line. It is recommended to come early, as the clinic is also very popular with the locals. Everything was finished by 9:15 am.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: I was helped very well. Very friendly staff. I arrived at 8 a.m. and was back outside by 9:30. Everything went very smoothly. Excellent!! Thank you to the caregivers.❤️

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: Got food poisoning on my short trip to Chiang Mai and needed immediate solution for stomach pains and diarrhea to continue traveling. Read some reviews and saw the doctor here speaks English. Got here at 7:45am Monday and there was already a queue as its first come first serve. The process was very efficient thought, i got seen within the hour. The doctor does speak fluent English and asked for detailed recap of what happened and a short physical exam before prescribing me antibiotics. My symptoms got better within the day i was very relieved. Also it was only 460 baht for the visit and meds. Highly recommend.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: I arrived about 10 minutes before opening and so i was done within about an hour. I had an x-ray and many other things. The doctor speaks great English and listened well. He's kind and the price is very comfortable.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: Very sweet and holistic doctor! Be there early, to avoid a long wait. The doctor gave me wholeheartedly advice instead of just prescribing medication. First I was disappointed , now I see he was more than right. Speaks perfect English and is a gentle soul. Paid 300 bath for consultation and medication.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text:
Friendly staff. Effective doctor. Very reasonable fees.

If at all possible please implement a queuing system where people who wait from early morning like 7am until opening time at 8am get to see the doctor before people who arrive late and jump the queue.

Please wear a mask inside the clinic if you don't have one buy one at the 7/11 just a few meters away.

It's embarrassing to see some foreigners arriving late jumping the queue and having to be told several times to wear a mask!

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text:
Best doctor in Chiang Mai by far! And very cheap and affordable!
I went there at 8:30am and I got told I had a 2h wait. The actual doctor walked in at 9:30 but I went earlier to be first in the cue. Some people left and came back after, I didn’t want to take the risk so I stayed. Doctor spoke very good English and was very professional. I got a mini surgery done there and got given antibiotics, painkillers and antibacterial cream for an infected foot. I paid 570bahts including the medication. If you need a doctor in Chiang Mai look not further and get there ASAP!

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text:
Friday 7:45 a.m. - 5 people waiting

8:00 a.m. - 15 people

8:25 a.m. - 24 people

9:45 a.m. - 35 people

It's not a very big place so, if you don't want to wait forever, get here at 7:30 sharp

You need to wear a proper mask. They won't accept anything else.

Drinking water available for free in the waiting area

I arrived at 7:45 and was completely finished with everything at 9:45

Got two x-rays completed and doctors consultation total price 560 baht

I was quoted 3000 baht at the Saipat hospital for the same thing

I busted my foot and thought I broke my toe, needed X-rays and doctors consultation

Doctor was very professional, spoke perfect English, knows what he's doing, staff was professional, about 20 seats in waiting room, no AC, only fans!

If you're on a budget I recommend this place

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: I visited the doctor for a bronchitis / sinusitis that did not want to go away (more than a month). The doctor was really nice, took some X-ray and did an exam while explaining what he was doing and how he came to his conclusion. I felt very safe and had a very good experience with him and all of his staff. You do need to get there early if you want to see the doctor. I got there around 8:45 am and I saw the doctor around noon. I would recommend going there as soon as it opens at 8 am. It costs me 1040 baht including X-ray and medication (15 days antibiotics and pills for my cough and congestion). He speaks good english and answered all my questions. I would recommend going to this clinic if like me you need to see a doctor for something that is not urgent but requires treatment while you are traveling in Chiang Mai.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text:
What a  happy doctor and so reasonable. He is probably in his 60s speaks fluent English and very competent .He is very popular and liked by the community. They do not take appointments so you must attend before 8.00am if you can ,to get a place in the queue. The doctor doesn’t arrive until after 9.30am.
You can leave and come back but if you loose your place bad luck.I was 3rd in line and saw the doctor at 10.00am. While I was waiting patients came in to see the doctor and after leaving their name were told to come back after 11.00 am. The pharmacist prepare the medication while you wait. They don’t give you a prescription to be filled. How great is that ! Total cost THB 480 incl the medication The guy is an angel.

text: They feel rushed which is fair enough don’t blame them. The first diagnosis was fine it was an ear infection in my right ear even I could have diagnosed that it was just if it was outer, middle or inner that mattered. And yet I did say that I had been feeling the same beginning symptoms in my left ear and he ignored them so now my left and right ear are infected and I don’t know if I have the pain killers and anti biotics to last me that long. I’m just kinda disappointed it was cheap though.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: The doctor was very professional and knowledgeable. The nurses and receptionists were also very friendly and helpful.. I was in an out of there in less than 20 minutes overall.. Their prices are very reasonable too.. I’m thankful that there’s such a good clinic out here in Chiang Mai!

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: I can’t be more grateful with the Doctor for his excellent attention. He spoke fluent English and he was very professional and kind. Also, the price was really good. He diagnosed and medicated me effectively. If you had the opportunity to visit him, let him know that his Colombian patient is still grateful with him . Thank you Le Routard for the advice on this doctor. (I also recommend to eat the Malaysian rottis you will find just in front)

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: Very nice, English speaking and good doctor. I like that he can make urine and blood (?) tests on the spot, also has an x-ray. Thing is his prices are really low and that's why usually Burmese and Thais with low income come here. As a foreigner I feel it would be inappropriate to make the queue longer than it is already if you have an insurance which would cover any more expensive clinic or hospital as well. I come here with my Burmese gf who unfortunately doesn't have any kind of insurance and we feel in very good hands and are thankful for having this doctor.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: Great experience. Arrived around 5pm and waited for 30-45 minutes. Definitely not that bad. Comfy chairs and fans. Doctor was courteous and kind. Spoke fluent English yay! Best part is the location. Close to the old city, no need for a taxi! I was given antibiotics for an infection on my elbow, and the visit was only 350THB

text: It was so affordable only 200tbh for both medicine and doctor fee. The doctor is English speaking and very experienced. I had a severe throat pain. I couldnn't eat or drink and only after a day seeing doctor I can start eating again. So thankful for the experience 😇 …

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: Best clinic I've ever been to. Long wait so get there early in the morning or at 4:30pm. Very professional and affordable. I won't get into the specifics of my visit, I'll just say I could not have gotten better service...Doctor speaks fluent English.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text:
I ve been a patient of Dr Tawatchai and his clinic staff  for 35 years . Im 70 now and in great health .
My brother and several other members of my family are also doctors so I often consult with them before or after visiting the clinic . To make a long story short Dr Tawatchai has always cured my problems and his strategy has always been spot on with what I was advised would be the approach by medical professionals in Canada. He 's recommended the very best specialists in CM for me and subtly and with great diplomacy steered me away from others.
Most recently we saw him for annual health check up .First time we have had it done in Thailand (covid has  had us here for almost 2 years now,).
It was extremely thorough .chest and abdomen x ray EKG and myriad blood tests  etc. Blood drawn in the morning all lab results by 6 pm and a very thorough explanation of all results including very diplomatic suggestions on what he would recommend as strategies to stay healthy or remedy issues.
There is no computers in his office {maybe one at the reception now)
so he looks a you not a computer screen when you visit. He was great doctor 35 years ago and he has aged like fine wine . I cant say enough about him . Fine doctor and fine human being as are all his staff.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: Nice, courteous, and professional staff. The clinic was very busy in the afternoon so the wait was long, but this isn't the fault of the clinic. Both the doctor and nurse spoke fluent English and were patient.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic
text: Best clinic in Chiang Mai. Really professional and knowledgeable doctor who go straight to the point. Every time I’ve visit it’s been one time and I’ve recover what ever problem I’ve had. Recommended for everybody!

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic

Laughs a lot.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic

text: The doctor is skilled and friendly. The clinic has music playing while waiting, with a 70s-80s atmosphere. All the staff provide excellent service. The price is not expensive. The treatment is truly cured because they know the cause of the disease and diagnose it accurately. I recommend it.

restaurant_name: ลอยเคราะห์คลินิก Loi Kroh Medical Clinic

Thank you.
